sources.excerpt: Assessing the power and selecting the test markets for a GeoLift test can be accomplished through the GeoLiftMarketSelection() function. Through a series of simulations, this algorithm will find which are the best combinations of test and control locations for the experiment.
additional_excerpts: Every GeoLift experiment should contain at least these three variables that reflect when, where, and how much of the KPI was measured.
The ideal test length heavily depends on the product and vertical we are working with.
To show an end-to-end implementation of GeoLift we will use simulated data of 40 US cities across 90 days
The main metric of model fit used in GeoLift is the L2 Imbalance which represents how far our synthetic control was from the actual observed values in the pre-treatment period.
sources.scope_limit: Documentación de una biblioteca externa, no evidencia de que Velz la use. No se ejecutó R, GeoLift ni análisis de potencia geográfico real. Sus ejemplos simulados no se convierten en clientes o resultados propios.

sources.supported_claim: Los experimentos pueden informar priors de MMM; la transferencia requiere incertidumbre adicional y considerar periodo, población, granularidad y diferencia de contrafactual.
sources.excerpt: Although experiments provide highly relevant information, remember that translating them into an MMM prior involves an additional layer of uncertainty beyond just the experiment's standard error.
additional_excerpts: Calibration is the process of using experiment results and other domain knowledge to set channel-specific priors.

Estimand differences: The MMM counterfactual is zero spend, whereas some experiments might define ROI against a different baseline, such as reduced spend (a non-zero counterfactual). Experiments measuring marginal lift introduce an estimand mismatch with the MMM's zero-spend counterfactual.
sources.scope_limit: No implica que Velz utilice Meridian o sus herramientas. La dependencia entre calibración y validación se explica como límite lógico, no como ensayo ejecutado.

power_illustration.assumptions: Serie única de diferencias relativas semanales independientes y normales; desviación conocida; contraste bilateral de significación 0.05 y potencia 0.80; efecto 0.05. Ignora autocorrelación, ajuste del control y estructura por zonas.
power_illustration.limit: No utilizar para recomendar duración; el diseño real requiere simulación con su histórico.

financial_illustration.limit: No se estimó contrafactual ni intervalo estadístico; supuestos contables sintéticos, no datos de negocio ni previsión.
